top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a fundamental endocrine discovery whose mechanism, maturity, and sustained therapeutic consequences in diabetes and obesity form the strongest available discovery-to-medical-benefit case. Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker are a coherent allocation when the citation is confined to GLP-1 physiology and therapeutic enablement rather than later development of individual medicines.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict is apparent from the supplied profile. My documented collaboration with fellow member Per Svenningsson does not identify a connection to a shortlisted candidate.
